convention.rel_site: NAME.rel+0xOFF is an offset in the REL file (sections keep their vanilla file offsets in the patched REL): the convention of mods/betterww/options.txt; DolRecomp resolves it as the module base plus OFF. wwrando's own paths (rels/NAME.rel@XXXX) use the same offsets
convention.code_sites: one row per 4-byte instruction word; patched_insn is the baseline run's word (default options, seed RV1), register is the destination (li/lis/addi) or compared register (cmpwi); the value of the site is the varying byte(s) given by varying_byte_offsets (offset 3 is the low byte of an immediate)
